summary: Escrow iteration testing completed. Core regression APIs passed and Stripe Checkout session creation works, but seeded contract records lack escrow fields, breaking the fund button and released-deal guard.

critical.issue: Existing seeded Launch Week Sprint and Marathon Expo Booth documents are missing funding_status (and related escrow fields), although server seed definitions now require them. Seed exits when users already exist, so no migration repairs old records.
Because the seeded released deal has no funding_status, POST checkout for Marathon Expo Booth returns 200 and creates a Stripe session instead of the required 400 released/double-fund guard.

ui_bugs.issue: Launch Week Sprint is visibly unfunded but company sees only an unfunded pill; Fund escrow button is absent because funding_status is undefined in the API response.

action_items: Backfill funding_status=unfunded, funded_at, released_at, and stripe_session_id on existing contracts, or add an idempotent startup migration.
Re-run escrow tests after migration; verify released deals return 400 and unfunded company deals show Fund escrow.
Complete one real test-card payment and verify status polling, idempotent settle, release, and creator notification after the data migration.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() returns immediately whenever users exist, so adding new required fields to seed documents does not update an already-initialized database; schema evolution needs an explicit migration/defaulting path.
payment_status suppresses all Stripe/status exceptions with a bare except, which can leave users in pending state without observable API error details.

success_rate.frontend: 83% executed payment states and contract flow (5/6)

seed_data_creation: No persistent test data retained. Two temporary Stripe checkout transactions were created for seeded deals and deleted immediately; no card payment was completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo company login, overview, contracts navigation, escrow panel, cancel page, and success page without session_id passed. Actual payment was not completed in this iteration. AI remains intentionally MOCKED/DISABLED. Fix/backfill existing contract escrow fields before retesting.
rca of the issue: The database was initialized by an earlier server version. server.py seed() only seeds when users.count_documents({}) == 0; after escrow fields were added to the seed literals, startup skipped the seed path. Existing contract documents therefore omit funding_status. Contracts API passes those documents unchanged, Contracts.jsx treats undefined as non-unfunded and renders a status pill instead of the company fund button. The same missing field bypasses create_deal_checkout's funded/released guards, allowing checkout on the released Marathon deal.
